title: Leo's trade, page 5: the one rule he changes

body.hook: Page five of five. Reading his notes, Leo spots a pattern.
body.promise: The urge to trade again came within minutes of the stop.

beats.narration: So he adds one rule. After any stop, wait fifteen minutes before looking for another trade.
He will check that rule against his journal next week. It might help, or it might not.

scene.label: Next week
scene.text: Did the rule help? Check the journal.
scene.caption: Test it. Don't assume it.

beats.narration: Trading carries a real risk of loss.

body.cta: That's today's page from my notes. See you tomorrow. — James
